briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Items outside this window are marked as background.

**Source gaps:** The results include no hires, and no product launches beyond a marketing campaign.

## Deals

- **Reported acquisition by Globex Corporation.** The company has reportedly agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, per people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). *Caveat: the snippet does not name Zepto. Confirm the target before relying on this.*
- **Funding (background, outside window).** Tavily's profile lists a $100M venture round dated 1 July 2026 and a $450M Series H dated 16 November 2025 (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58).

## Marketing and Campaigns

- **Seoul Street / anime campaign.** Zepto's brand push drew coverage in October. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta is quoted, and Zepto declined to name the next fandom. Fans were due to queue in Hyderabad on 14 November (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago).

## Festive Trading

- **Dhanteras.** Zepto reported delivering over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm).
- **Diwali baskets.** Zepto recorded 3X growth in festive hamper orders versus last Diwali, and fashion purchases doubled, led by ethnic wear (https://www.ndtvprofit.com/business/from-gold-coins-to-diet-coke-what-diwali-shopping-carts-reveal-about-indias-consumption-12309693). *The article's phrasing is ambiguous about whether the fashion figure is Zepto-specific.*

## Workforce and People

- **Extra holiday.** Zepto moved its post-Diwali holiday from Tuesday to Monday. Chief HR officer Sneha Arora cited a longer family weekend (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms).
- **Bonus backlash.** A viral video of a delivery partner receiving "cash-like coupons" instead of a bonus drew criticism of worker welfare (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html). A social media post also cited a "valuation 7 billion" figure, which is unverified (same source).

## Regulatory

- **Maharashtra FDA action.** The FDA suspended food licences for Blinkit, Zepto and 103 others, out of 105 suspended licences statewide. The actions were taken on 4 and 5 November (https://www.rediff.com/news/commentary/2026/nov/06/fda-suspends-food-licence-of-blinkit-zepto-103-others/14358878a29915ea01709670aa484bc5).

## Open Questions

1. Is Zepto the company in the reported Globex acquisition, and what does the deal mean for our discussions and timing?
2. What is the status of the Maharashtra food licence suspensions, and what steps are being taken to restore operations?
3. How is Zepto addressing the Diwali bonus concerns and delivery-partner compensation, and will the bonus structure change?
